scoring_justification: Full recompute of Eliashberg equations impossible in verifier; score structural properties (Tc, reentrance, normalization) and plausibility ranges alongside a few approximate reference values from paper figures.

outputs.description: Table of computed superconducting gaps and normalized superfluid density for the two-band spin-glass Eliashberg model. The checker will compare the agent’s reported Δ₁, Δ₂, and n_s values at selected temperature points against hidden reference values extracted from the paper’s figures, within defined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The reference match compares against the paper’s original results (hidden). The solver implementation details (grid size, convergence criteria, solver method) are the agent’s choice; the tolerance accounts for legitimate implementation spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Approximate reference values for gaps and superfluid density at selected points, derived from paper figures.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual inspection and digitization approximations; tolerances set wide to absorb implementation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are approximate but derived from the same published curves; the physical invariants (Tc, normalization, reentrance) define the scoring.
